title: The stage backfill stores small batches that each finish well under the statement timeout
description: On a running test install seeded with 800-row delta chains on 180 KB documents, where one 1,000-row batch runs past the statement timeout, the loop's stage backfill starts at 50 rows, sizes each batch to take about 2 seconds, reports progress each cycle, and finishes; master status names no backfill statement over 5 seconds.

steps.name: the backfill reports progress each cycle and master status names no backfill statement over 5 s
